title: Velvety Corn Pudding
description: A creamy and comforting dessert made with dried corn and velvety texture.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together dried white corn, velvety cream, floral honey, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whip folded egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold egg whites into the corn mixture until well combined.
Pour the mixture into 6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the edges are set and the centers are slightly jiggly.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
